_note: General guidance (prevention and monitoring only). reviewed=false until a specialist matches it against IPM UC. No pesticide recipes.

actions: Remove heavily infected leaves and dispose of them away from the crop
Improve ventilation and reduce plant crowding
Check new leaves every 2-3 days
cucumber:powdery_mildew.ipm_note: Favored by RH 50-90% and moderate temperatures; resistant varieties, sanitation, weed control, monitor from vegetative stage

actions: Reduce leaf wetness and avoid overhead irrigation
Improve ventilation, especially at night
Isolate infected plants and monitor spread
